svg.text: outp - vcm = vcm - outn = pad - vref
slot (slot7_wrapper-compatible), SLOT FALLBACK of the pad cells: both pad macros sit inside the slot and use the harness IOPadAnalog pads.
Rails: iovdd = vdd_3v3, iovss = vss_3v3, core ring vdd = vdd_1v2, vss = vss_1v2. D2S drives s7_an[1] (the bare pad node); S2D reads s7_an_0_esd (behind the harness 587 Ohm secondary protection).

Chain S2D -> D2S (internal filter off). vref = vcm = vbias (harness voltage bias). ibias0 -> D2S, ibias1 -> S2D (both sourced, 5 uA = code 20). Bias select: dig_in[1:0] -> D2S, dig_in[3:2] -> S2D. enable -> both.
Priority route (custom padframe cells) needs slot7_wrapper / padframe changes; see macros/slot/README.md. Unused here: clk, reset, dig_out, analog_bus[3:0], dig_in[23:4].
One generator per pad: each pad has its own en_ctrl_3v3 (level shift of enable and the two select bits) and its own bias_gen_pd (Oguey-Aebischer core,
bandgap core or the harness ibias through a switch, chosen by the select bits); the generator's iref is the pad's 5 uA reference current.
[S2D] single-to-differential pad xs2d with its own enable control xs2d_c and bias generator xs2d_g
xs2d_c (en_ctrl_3v3) and xs2d_g (bias_gen_pd): outside the pad cell since 2026-11-04 (backannotation to the drawn cell),
wired as in the former pad sheet; the sources that drove the old pad pins now drive them.
[D2S] differential-to-single pad xd2s with its own enable control xd2s_c and bias generator xd2s_g
xd2s_c (en_ctrl_3v3) and xd2s_g (bias_gen_pd): outside the pad cell since 2026-11-03 (backannotation to the drawn cell),
wired as in the former pad sheet; the sources that drove the old pad pins now drive them.
